prompt: could you rewrite  Ralph Bakshi's cool world as an animated film. Use every standard punctuation mark at least once, including semicolons, colons, and the interrobang (?!).
judge_reasoning: All four candidates provide an original “reimagined film pitch,” but they vary a lot in how faithfully they rewrite Cool World’s core premise and vibe. Candidate 2 most closely matches the source’s two-world premise, noir tone, and especially includes a character concept aligned with Cool World’s “Jack” (roguish detective), with rules about humans vs. cartoons and a catastrophic merging plot. Candidate 4 is also in the right genre and structure (barrier breaking, living cartoons, noir chase/showdown) but drifts more on character alignment. Candidate 1 stays on-theme but is more generic, while Candidate 3 significantly reframes the story (sketchbook/dimension via sentient self-portrait) and even shifts to a more youth/PG framing.
